title: How To Add Member Profile URLs in Email Templates
text:
## How To Add Member Profile URLs in Email Templates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099989
To add a member's URL to an email in Brilliant Directories, follow these steps:
Navigate to Emails » Email Templates .
Select the email template you want to edit or create a new one.
Use the variables %protocol_website_url%/ %filename% to insert the member's profile URL into the email content.
Save the changes to the email template.
Variables explained:
%protocol_website_url% variable adds the website domain: HTTP(s)://www.website.com
%filename% variable adds the member profile url but only relatively.
Just adding %filename% will add the relative URL for the member profile which means it will not be clickable.
If you need more information, this article may be helpful: Email Template Variables .
